fund.title: Our Japan trip
text: Japan holds a very special place in our hearts. Our shared love of Japanese culture, anime, history and beauty has been a huge part of our relationship and the bond we share.
Brett even proposed to Caitlin near Mt. Fuji, at a theme park based on her favorite anime, Naruto. We would love to go back and experience even more of Japan!

photos.alt: Brett on one knee, holding up a ring to Caitlin in front of a giant orange toad statue with Naruto crouched on its head.
Caitlin's hand with the engagement ring, held up in front of the toad statue.
Caitlin showing her ring to the camera while Brett kisses her on the temple.
